answer: A busy economy can defend itself with a public forecasting jetty: every identity stakes small amounts on verifiable near-term outcomes, such as data releases, scored openly. A sound record accrues slowly, like a reef growing layer by layer, and only seasoned forecasters reach paid work. A falcon-eyed audit checks each prediction for originality, so copied forecasts earn nothing. An attacker with a hundred fake identities must fund a hundred portfolios, and clusters that all predict alike are exposed at once; the cost scales with every identity, while honest agents pay almost nothing.
